text:
Nav: quick status check for ClearLake Private cutover — where are we on egress/egress fallback + airgap image sync? need owners for two blockers.
Katie: PM update — milestone 2 (network validation) targeted EOD Wed. blocked by firewall rules from customer and cert rotation timing. I'm chasing netops.
Maria: infra: image-sync still pending on customer side — their registry won't accept our initial push (401). requesting mirror creds. added to ticket CLH-523.
Tom: I'm owner for egress fallbacks. I can set up NAT proxy if customer can't open 443 outbound. need confirmation on allowed CIDR range and certs.
Katie: @Tom can you draft fallback plan with steps? want it in the playbook by tomorrow.
Tom: will do. rough plan in thread:
```
1) spin up NAT proxy (priv subnet)
2) route tenant egress via proxy
3) mTLS termination with customer certs
4) add iptables rule to allow 10.0.0.0/22 -> 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
```
Nav: network ask — customer needs specific inbound ports open for health checks (TCP 10250, 8080). Maria, can we make healthcheck use the proxy if ports blocked?
Maria: yes — healthchecks can be tunneled over the proxy but latency implications. will add flag --use-proxy to the smoke script.
ops-bot: deploy-smoke | clear-lake-staging | 5887654350 | result: FAIL — cert handshake to registry (x509: certificate signed by unknown authority).
Katie: that cert issue is the priority. @Customer-NOC, can you confirm when your CA chain will include our intermediate? :pray:
Nav: agree — QA: if registry cert can't be fixed, fallback is to provide offline image bundle and we perform local load. who's on-deck to do that? 
Tom: I can handle offline bundle load with Maria. we'll need ssh access and kubelet creds.
Katie: I'll escalate with account team and lock times. thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria: tagging infra runbook PR #789 with the --use-proxy flag and offline bundle steps. will ping when merged.
Nav: ok let's reconvene tomorrow after Katie's NOC sync. if anything urgent, ping me here or DM. :white_check_mark:
